identity.name: Elara Voss
identity.backstory: Elara Voss grew up in a secluded elven temple, serving as an acolyte to the goddess of light and healing. When a shadowy cult razed her home and slew her mentors, she took up her holy symbol to avenge them and bring justice to the wicked.

identity.name: Kaelen Ironfist
identity.backstory: Kaelen served in the dwarven infantry for decades before his clan was scattered by a dragon attack. Now a mercenary, he seeks to earn enough gold to rebuild his ancestral home.

identity.name: Lyra Shadowbrook
identity.backstory: Lyra grew up on the streets, learning to pick pockets and navigate the city's underbelly to survive. Her quick wit and nimble fingers kept her out of trouble, but she longs for a purpose beyond mere survival.

identity.name: Thorne Emberheart
identity.backstory: Thorne was a studious apprentice in a grand library, where he uncovered ancient tomes of magic that ignited his passion for the arcane arts. After his mentor vanished under mysterious circumstances, he set out to seek greater knowledge and power. Now, he joins the party to unravel the world's mysteries and protect it from dark forces.

identity.name: Finnian Quickstrumming
identity.backstory: Finnian grew up in the cozy taverns of a halfling shire, mastering lute and song to delight patrons and slyly fill his pockets. A brush with goblins during a festival ignited his wanderlust, prompting him to trade tavern stages for heroic quests. With his enchanting melodies and roguish wit, he bolsters allies and beguiles foes wherever adventure calls.
